newsitem.title: GERMANY: TENNIS-INJURED HUBER FOLLOWS GRAF OUT OF FED CUP TIE.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-INJURED HUBER FOLLOWS GRAF OUT OF FED CUP TIE.

text.p: Germany will be forced to field a second-string line-up in this weekend's Fed Cup tie against the Czech Republic after Anke Huber followed world number one Steffi Graf by pulling out because of injury.
The German number two, ranked seventh in the world, said she would be out of action for two weeks because of a torn shoulder ligament.
Graf said last week she had been ordered to take a four-week break because of inflammation in her left knee.
